h:
使用一些不同的自定义节点从头开始构建此工作流程，以提高效率和更清晰的布局。它与多种模型配合良好。将正面提示分为两部分可以创建大批量相似风格的图像。

使用的自定义节点
- https://github.com/SeargeDP/SeargeSDXL
- https://github.com/wallish77/wlsh_nodes
- https://github.com/ltdrdata/ComfyUI-Impact-Pack

o.en:
Built this workflow from scratch using a few different custom nodes for efficiency and a cleaner layout. It has worked well with a variety of models. Separating the positive prompt into two sections has allowed for creating large batches of images of similar styles.

Custom Nodes Used
- https://github.com/SeargeDP/SeargeSDXL
- https://github.com/wallish77/wlsh_nodes
- https://github.com/ltdrdata/ComfyUI-Impact-Pack
